items.title: Hank Cicalo interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, April 30, 2022
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] ...If Billy Mays wrote a score or something — [INTERVIEWEE] Absolutely.

ctx.x: I mean by old producers I mean guys who were musicians to begin with, they were steady guys, they worked for RCA or Columbia or whatever, they were company oriented. They had so much to do in a date and they would try to make — if there were three tunes a date we did three tunes a date. It depends on the artist. I mean you can’t stifle, I’ve seen it happen boy and that’s the worst thing in the world, where you get a producer to say, “All right come on let’s go. Hurry up.” I never felt you ever got them to…
Yeah it’s interesting that you said some of the older producers were musicians first. Like they could read the score. If Billy Mays wrote a score or something —
